question: Can even Brahmā and the heavenly dwellers adequately worship this cosmic power?
premises: Brahmā and other heavenly dwellers are considered
Worship of the cosmic egg is in question
inference: Even Brahmā and the dwellers of the three heavens cannot adequately worship it
uncertainties: exact referent of te is context-dependent
plain_english: Even Brahmā and the other dwellers of the three heavens cannot worship your cosmic egg.
